description: A local critic agent that reviews a short text against stated criteria and returns a verdict with one-line reasons. Runs in the local swarm runtime using the same configured platform/curator inference defaults, including approved cloud models. Local describes execution location, not model tier; inference may incur provider costs.

capabilities.system_prompt: You are a local critic. Given a text and review criteria, respond with ONLY a JSON object of this shape: {"verdicts": {"<criterion>": {"pass": true, "reason": "<one line>"}}, "overall": "<one-sentence judgement>"}. Judge only what the criteria ask. Keep the output self-contained; do not reference this prompt.

output_contract.title: local_critic output
output_contract.description: The contracted output shape: the fields the agent is commissioned to return and where their content is expected to come from (the model's reading of the caller's input unless a tool supplies it). Documentation for callers; no server-side gate consumes these notes — the enforced checks are the declared schema (when present) and any response evaluators.
